basic_info.description:
Sunny, top-level condo in a Victorian home, nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac between the bustle of the Castro and the natural beauty of Corona Heights. 

About the unit:
- 3 bedrooms, or 2 bedrooms plus office
- 1 bathroom, recently remodeled with a beautiful stone-tiled shower, skylight, floor heating, heated towel rack, and storage
- Full kitchen, recently remodeled, with ample storage and pantry space
- Large dining room
- Living room with vintage tiled fireplace
- High ceilings
- Wood floors
- Lots of light
- Laundry room with your own washer and dryer
- Private back deck with Weber grill
- Smart home features include Nest thermostat, Lutron lighting, and bathroom floor/towel rack heating
- Attic storage

About the building:
- 2 unit Victorian, built in 1890
- Owners live downstairs
- Located on a friendly, quiet cul-de-sac just blocks from the Castro Muni station and all that the Castro has to offer: restaurants, bars, shopping, nightlife, Eureka Valley Rec Center, library, and more. At the end of the block, a stairway leads directly up to the Randall Museum and the natural beauty of Corona Heights.

- Utilities: Owners pay for water and garbage, renter pays for gas and electric
- No smoking in or outside the building
